entries.en: Added support for native Windows (requires Git for Windows)
entries.zh: 添加了对本机 Windows 的支持（Windows 需要 Git）

entries.en: Added support for Bedrock API keys through environment variable AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
entries.zh: 通过环境变量 AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK 添加了对 Bedrock API 密钥的支持

entries.en: Settings: /doctor can now help you identify and fix invalid setting files
entries.zh: 设置：`/doctor` 现在可以帮你找出并修复无效的设置文件

entries.en: `--append-system-prompt` can now be used in interactive mode, not just --print/-p.
entries.zh: `--append-system-prompt` 现在可用于交互模式，不再仅限于 --print/-p

entries.en: OTEL resource now includes os.type, os.version, host.arch, and wsl.version (if running on Windows Subsystem for Linux)
entries.zh: OTEL 资源现在包含 os.type、os.version、host.arch，以及（在 Windows 子系统 Linux 中运行时的）wsl.version

entries.en: Increased auto-compact warning threshold from 60% to 80%
entries.zh: 将自动压缩警告阈值从 60% 提高到 80%

entries.en: Fixed an issue with handling user directories with spaces for shell snapshots
entries.zh: 修复了处理带有 shell 快照空间的用户目录的问题

entries.en: Custom slash commands: Fixed user-level commands in subdirectories
entries.zh: 自定义斜杠命令：修复了子目录中的用户级命令

entries.en: Plan mode: Fixed issue where rejected plan from sub-task would get discarded
entries.zh: 计划模式：修复了子任务中被拒绝的计划会被丢弃的问题
